# Platte Valley Airpark (18V)
> General aviation airport on Colorado's Front Range, north of Denver near Fort Lupton.

Platte Valley Airpark is a community general aviation airport with over 60 years of history, home to 100+ based aircraft. Known for its friendly pilot community, dual runways, and competitive fuel pricing. Uncontrolled, public-use airport. No landing fee.

## Key Facts
- FAA Identifier: 18V
- Location: 7507 County Road 39, Fort Lupton, CO 80621
- CTAF: 122.9
- Pattern Altitude: 5,500 ft MSL
- Field Elevation: 4,934 ft MSL
- Fuel: 100LL self-serve, $6.65/gal, 24/7 credit card (no attendant)
- Runways: 4,100 ft paved (Runway 15/33) + 2,500 ft grass strip (Runway 9/27 — taildragger and backcountry training)
- Based aircraft: 100+
- Landing fee: None
- Manager: Erin Shoffit — erin@plattevalleyairpark.com
- Founded: 1966 (60+ years ago)

## Facilities
- Self-serve fuel pump (24/7, credit card, no attendant required)
- T-hangars and based aircraft storage
- Hangar House: aviation-themed on-site Airbnb accommodation
- No control tower — uncontrolled airspace (CTAF 122.9)
- Density altitude advisory: field elevation approximately 4,900 ft MSL — plan accordingly in summer

## The Hangar House
Unique aviation-themed overnight accommodation located on the airport property. Fully refurbished 1,704 sq ft ranch-style home (built 1942). Sleeps up to 5 guests. Includes aircraft tie-down, 2 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, large kitchen, fireplace, WiFi, and direct runway access. Available on Airbnb. Ideal for fly-in guests, aviation enthusiasts, and travelers visiting the Colorado Front Range.
- Airbnb link: https://airbnb.com/h/18vhangarhouse
- Page: https://www.plattevalleyairpark.com/hangar-house

## Common Questions

Q: Does 18V have self-serve fuel?
A: Yes — 100LL self-serve at $6.65/gal, available 24/7 with a credit card. No attendant required.

Q: What is the CTAF at Platte Valley Airpark?
A: 122.9 MHz. Platte Valley Airpark (18V) is an uncontrolled airport — no tower. Announce on 122.9.

Q: Can taildraggers land at 18V?
A: Yes — the 2,500 ft grass strip (Runway 9/27) is ideal for taildraggers and backcountry aircraft training. The paved main runway (15/33) is 4,100 ft.

Q: Is there overnight accommodation at the airport?
A: Yes — the Hangar House is an aviation-themed Airbnb on the airport property. Sleeps up to 5. Aircraft tie-down included with your stay.

Q: Where is Platte Valley Airpark?
A: Fort Lupton, Colorado, on the Front Range north of Denver — about 40 minutes from the Denver metro. FAA identifier 18V. Address: 7507 County Road 39, Fort Lupton, CO 80621.

Q: What is the runway length at 18V?
A: Two runways: 4,100 ft paved (Runway 15/33) and 2,500 ft grass (Runway 9/27).

Q: Is there a landing fee at Platte Valley Airpark?
A: No. There is no landing fee at 18V.

Q: How do I join the hangar waitlist at 18V?
A: Visit https://www.plattevalleyairpark.com/hangars or email erin@plattevalleyairpark.com.

Q: What is the pattern altitude at 18V?
A: 5,500 ft MSL.

Q: Who owns Platte Valley Airpark?
A: Platte Valley Airpark is owned by Dave Shull through Delta Zulu, a Front Range aviation portfolio company. The airpark manager is Erin Shoffit.
